notes.title: Story
notes.text: Since the winter of 1924, people and objects have vanished from Arkham—and even from memory. Similar reports around the world lead the investigators into an international mystery. After accepting Inspector Li Flint’s offer, the group follows the trail through Boston to London and encounters the Red-Gloved Man.

notes.title: Choices
items: William Yorick went alone to the meeting, as requested.
The investigators accepted Flint’s offer and agreed to report their findings to him.

notes.title: Consequences
items: Resolution 2. All three investigators survived.
Victory display: 6. Akachi, Norman, and Yorick each earned 6 XP; no physical or mental trauma. The purchased upgrades are recorded below.
William Yorick became the bearer of The Eye of Ravens.
Campaign note: You haven’t seen the last of the Red-Gloved Man.
Time: +1 before the scenario and +1 after its resolution; total 2.
Chaos bag: remove 1 elder thing token; add 1 tablet token.

notes.title: Story
notes.text: Commissioner Taylor questions the investigators. Flint introduces the Foundation and its work against the Coterie. The investigators become an independent cell and receive leads across the world.

notes.title: Choices
items: The cell did not tell Taylor about the disappearances.
The investigators embarked from London.

notes.title: Consequences
items: Campaign note: The cell hid the truth from Taylor.
Chaos bag: remove 1 tablet token; add 1 elder thing token.
Time passed remains 2. No additional XP award is recorded.

notes.title: Leads received
items: Shanghai: a woman with a red parasol and a secret cabal. Alexandria: beastly killings. Buenos Aires: high-profile burglaries and a possible key.
Nairobi: a sanctum. Anchorage: a prospector’s journal. Constantinople: a possible defector.
Kathmandu: a spirit resembling an operative. Marrakesh: a dangerous operative, tomb robberies, and overgrowth. Havana: smuggling.
